_meta.purpose: Version-controlled country/region -> likely-madhhab(s) mapping, feeding the 'I don't know my madhhab' onboarding suggestion (never a declaration). Per the charter: explicit country/city outranks phone-prefix; phone prefix is never proof of residence or madhhab; multi-madhhab countries return multiple options; low-confidence stays unresolved; user confirmation is always required before a suggestion becomes authoritative.
_meta.warning: AI-drafted from general, well-established historical/demographic knowledge about regional madhhab distribution (the kind found in any comparative-Islam textbook or encyclopedia entry) -- NOT independently verified by a qualified reviewer this session, and NOT based on any live census/survey data source. Every entry is 'confidence: DRAFT_UNVERIFIED' and 'reviewer_status: NOT_REVIEWED'. requires_user_confirmation is true on every single entry without exception -- this mapping must never be used to silently assign or declare a user's madhhab.
_meta.wording_contract: Any UI surfacing a suggestion from this file MUST use hedged wording equivalent to 'This madhhab is commonly followed in your region' -- NEVER 'You are Hanafi/Maliki/Shafi'i/Hanbali' -- enforced in code, see lib/features/onboarding/domain/services/madhhab_suggestion_service.dart.

Shafi'i is the historically and institutionally predominant madhhab across maritime Southeast Asia.

unresolved_policy: Any country not listed here, or any case this mapping marks 'low' confidence, must resolve to UNRESOLVED in the suggestion service -- the user sees the full 4-option-plus-unknown picker with no pre-selected/highlighted suggestion, never a guessed default.
scope_note: This is a deliberately small, seed list (13 country-level entries, 1 region-level override), not a comprehensive world mapping. Expanding coverage responsibly requires either sustained scholarly review or an explicit, resourced product decision -- listed as a follow-up, not attempted to be completed this pass.
